headline: IMF Projects 1.3% Contraction for Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan in 2026
summary: The International Monetary Fund forecasts a 1.3% economic contraction across the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan in 2026, citing significant disruptions to energy production and maritime shipping.
why: The MENA region supplies a major share of global seaborne crude oil, making its regional output crucial to international commodity markets.

impacts.name: MENA Energy Producers
impacts.why: Production outages and logistical disruptions directly reduce gross output across regional exporters.
